description: This file defines a static class 'Dependencies' with a method 'ConfigureServices' that configures database contexts for dependency injection, depending on configuration settings. It primarily sets up Entity Framework Core database contexts with either in-memory or SQL Server databases.

classes.name: Dependencies
classes.description: A static class providing a method to configure database services based on application configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Configures database contexts for dependency injection, choosing between in-memory and SQL Server based on configuration settings.
